steps.text: TOOLS BUG-4b (FIX_PLAN TOOLS clicks): at A1 in the reading view, the chip reader's visual centre presses the chip reader 10/10 (the torch's click box no longer swallows it), and the torch's own centre presses the torch 10/10. Day 18 has both machines by the plan (the reader comes on day 17; the three-week progression). Since Saleh's playtest of 2026-10-28, point 11, the tools answer in the reading view only (DeskTools), so the run turns to the reading view (Tab) before the clicks (integrate/s0800). The stills reader_readout_office (the office view) and reader_readout (the reading view, at 1080p and 5:4) show the painted reader with its readout line (READY: this scenario reads no chip; the code review's R3: the line must read from the chair); on the painted desk the painted mesh carries the reader's click box (seam D of 2026-10-28).
